summary: Carefully documented, preregistered paired confirmatory study that executed under shared_initial_candidate semantics and transparently reports a degenerate (ceiling) null outcome: every sampled initial candidate passed the deterministic validator, so no repairs occurred and guarded success equaled baseline (200/200). The manuscript is methodologically rigorous, preregistration-faithful, reproducible (artifacts archived, master-prompt digest present), and candid about the study's inferential limits and next-step designs needed to evaluate validator coverage and repair utility.
optional_revisions: Add a short formatted IEEE References section (numbered bibliography entries) using the verified bibliographic metadata so the final manuscript References follow a conventional IEEE bibliography layout (avoid raw DOI/arXiv-only lines if fuller metadata is available).

Include one brief exemplar validator-trace excerpt (as a short monospace block or compact table) inside the Results or Appendix to illustrate the validator's mechanistic checks for readers who will not inspect the archived artifacts.

In the Discussion, briefly restate that under shared_initial_candidate semantics any paired difference could arise only from validator-triggered repair (not from independent generator sampling), to reinforce how the design isolates validator/repair utility for reader clarity.
